```python
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader

current_dir = Path.cwd()
src_dir = current_dir / "src" if (current_dir / "src").is_dir() else current_dir

# Load at v1.0.0
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    old_repo = Path(tmpdir) / "v1"
    subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "-q", str(current_dir), str(old_repo)], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(old_repo), "checkout", "-q", "v1.0.0"], check=True)
    old_src = old_repo / "src" if (old_repo / "src").is_dir() else old_repo
    old_module = GriffeLoader(search_paths=[str(old_src)]).load_python("mypkg")

# Load at HEAD
new_module = GriffeLoader(search_paths=[str(src_dir)]).load_python("mypkg")

# Print all breakages
for breakage in old_module.get_breaking_changes(new_module):
    print(breakage)
```
